evals.prompt: I have names of 20 companies and only want their official website URLs. Research five first; don't fill any other fields or write to my database.
evals.expected_output: Only website proposals with exact retrieved URLs, explicit ambiguous/missing outcomes and a bounded paid-work gate.

evals.prompt: For this regional brand, find its official name, LinkedIn company page and HQ, noting a parent only if the sources actually support one.
evals.expected_output: Three independent sourced proposals; no substituted parent HQ/LinkedIn, no invented confidence or implicit website operation.

evals.prompt: Find potential buying champions at these target companies and their recent news.
evals.expected_output: Runs only requested people and news operations; seeks public current-role evidence and dated company news without inventing budget authority or contact data.

evals.prompt: Only research who owns these companies: the direct parent or controlling fund and any material disclosed stakes. If a report says owned by a fund but gives no percentage, leave the percentage unknown. Don't research personas or margins.
evals.expected_output: An independently selected ownership operation with dated source-backed owner roles and percentages typed as equity/voting/indirect or null when undisclosed; no invented cap table.

evals.prompt: I already have validated synthetic proposals in examples/proposals.json. Give me a CSV-first handoff with one row per company, separate ownership, people and news tables, and short Markdown briefs. No web research or account writes.
evals.expected_output: Dependency-free local CSV/Markdown output keyed by account ID; statuses separate from review decisions, ambiguous and not_requested distinct, optional JSON only on request.
